predecessor_preserved_findings.positive_narrow_result: For role-local repository-native outcomes, an immutable receipt can be non-critical when its exact reconstruction payload is committed in STATE first.
predecessor_preserved_findings.unresolved_child: A genuinely second correctness-critical repository/external effect still retains split-effect atomicity.
predecessor_preserved_findings.architecture_hypothesis: One immutable intent/event can be the sole correctness-critical material record when all additional views are deterministic, reconstructible, non-authoritative projections.

selected_leaf: Retry the append-only-intent plus deterministic-derived-view repository probe after prior write-surface failure, and verify an identical-content replay is a no-op.

source_qualified_precedent.title: Event Sourcing Pattern - Azure Architecture Center
source_qualified_precedent.relevant_contract: An append-only event stream can be the system of record; current state and materialized views can be regenerated by replaying events, with idempotent consumers required for repeated delivery.
source_qualified_precedent.scope: Architectural precedent only; no Azure service is part of this Phase-1 route.

replay_verification.method: Recompute the canonical non-authoritative projection from the exact-read immutable intent and compare it with the exact-read derived view; because the existing view content is identical, replay requires no repository write.

bounded_leaf_result.semantic_claim: Within the tested role-local repository scope, a nominally two-object outcome can avoid split-effect atomicity when exactly one immutable intent is correctness-critical and the second object is a deterministic, non-authoritative, reconstructible projection. An identical replay can be a no-op.
bounded_leaf_result.falsification_boundary: This does not solve a second object that has independent correctness-critical semantics or an external side effect; such a second effect remains an unresolved split-effect child.
